---
title: "PARI reference"
---

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Every PARI function, its ER2 name, and whether the prelude exposes it. Generated from `er2/data/pari_functions.csv`.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="er2-search">
  <input id="er2-search" type="search" placeholder="Search a PARI or ER2 name, or a word of the description"
         aria-label="Search the functions" style="width: 100%; padding: 0.4em; margin-bottom: 0.5em;">
  <label><input id="er2-exposed" type="checkbox"> Only what ER2 exposes (prelude, <code>pari.</code> and wrappers)</label>
  <p id="er2-count" style="margin-top: 0.5em;"></p>
</div>
<script>
// Filters the rows of the function tables below: the generated
// document is included as it is, and only hidden or shown here.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const box = document.getElementById("er2-search");
  const exposed = document.getElementById("er2-exposed");
  const count = document.getElementById("er2-count");
  // the function tables are the ones with a "Status" column
  const tables = [...document.querySelectorAll("main table")].filter(
    (t) => [...t.querySelectorAll("th")].some((th) => th.textContent.trim() === "PARI"));
  const rows = tables.flatMap((t) => [...t.querySelectorAll("tbody tr")]);
  const hidden = new Set(["python", "conflict"]);
  function update() {
    const words = box.value.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    let shown = 0;
    for (const row of rows) {
      const text = row.textContent.toLowerCase();
      const status = (row.cells[2]?.textContent || "").trim();
      const ok = words.every((w) => text.includes(w)) && !(exposed.checked && hidden.has(status));
      row.style.display = ok ? "" : "none";
      shown += ok;
    }
    for (const table of tables) {
      const any = [...table.querySelectorAll("tbody tr")].some((r) => r.style.display !== "none");
      // hide a whole topic when none of its functions matches
      const node = table.closest("section.level2") || table;
      node.style.display = any ? "" : "none";
    }
    count.textContent = `${shown} of ${rows.length} functions`;
  }
  // ?find=eulerphi links straight to a search (Quarto's own search uses ?q=)
  const query = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("find");
  if (query) box.value = query;
  box.addEventListener("input", update);
  exposed.addEventListener("change", update);
  update();
});
</script>
```
